question: Which tools are associated with defects?

candidates.query: SELECT DISTINCT ?t WHERE { ?l a :Lot . ?d a :Defect . ?t a :Tool . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . ?t :USED_IN ?d . }
SELECT DISTINCT ?t WHERE { ?l a :Lot . ?d a :Defect . ?t a :Tool . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . ?t :PROCESSED_WITH ?d . }
SELECT DISTINCT ?t WHERE { ?l a :Lot . ?d a :Defect . ?t a :Tool . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . ?t :USED_IN ?d . }
SELECT DISTINCT ?t WHERE { ?l a :Lot . ?d a :Defect . ?t a :Tool . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . ?l :PROCESSED_WITH ?t . }
SELECT DISTINCT ?t WHERE { ?l a :Lot . ?d a :Defect . ?t a :Tool . ?l :HAS_DEFECT ?d . ?t :USED_IN ?d . }
